sections.title: Early separation made softer
sections.lead: For many families, play school is a child's first regular experience away from home.
points: Children can settle gradually, build trust, and join simple routines without feeling pushed.
The environment stays lively enough for engagement and calm enough for security.
Teachers give children time to observe, warm up, and participate at their own pace.
sections.closing: First school experiences shape how children feel about learning and daily transitions.

sections.title: Play is the earliest learning language
sections.lead: Play is how young children discover language, movement, listening, imagination, and problem solving.
points: Children sing, speak, build, draw, move, pretend, and join joyful group moments.
Repeated routines and kind adults help children relax into the classroom setting.
The day encourages participation without too much noise, confusion, or pressure.
sections.closing: Rhythm and relationships help children feel ready for shared classroom life.

sections.title: Helpful for Velachery and nearby families
sections.lead: Families often prefer to begin the school journey close to home, while nearby access still matters.
points: A convenient location can make the first months smoother for both children and parents.
Useful for families from Guindy, Adambakkam, Madipakkam, Taramani, Perungudi, Nanganallur, and Saidapet.
Best understood through admissions information, the gallery, FAQs, and a direct conversation.
sections.closing: A child-centered play school should feel practical for families and familiar for children.
